All fourteen queries ran and gave plausible answers. I didn't check the answers against the data files by hand, apart from a first look at the top of each file. Two things to know:
- **T10:** the answer prints its service names as keywords (`:db 3`), not strings.
- **T3, T7:** these answers print as quoted-key maps, but I only inspected the printed output.

T1: `| /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count`
T2: `| /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)`
T3: `| /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)`
T4: `| /data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 2`
T5: `| filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort`
T6: `| sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)})`
T7: `| filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)`
T8: `| :d /devDependencies | /dependencies | union d | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~([(/0 | print | drop 1) "@" /1] | join "")`
T9: `| /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","`
T10: `| lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | map ~(count)`
T11: `| lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`
T12: `| lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2`
T13: `| lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) | entries | map ~({:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total (/1 | map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2)}) | sort ~([(/total | desc) /customer]) | take 2`
T14: `| ["Banana" "apple" "Cherry" "banana" "fig" "APPLE" "date" "kiwi" "Fig" "elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"`
